title: scriptc compiles ordinary TypeScript to native binaries with no Node and no V8 inside, from Vercel
description:
scriptc compiles ordinary TypeScript to native binaries with no Node and no V8 inside, from Vercel Labs. Real tsc does the typechecking, then lowering runs through a typed IR to LLVM or C. it reports statement by statement what compiles statically and names each blocker with an error code. Zero-runtime holds for the static path only. npm dependencies need dynamic mode, which embeds QuickJS. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/vercel-labs/scriptc
